criteria.description: A readable workbook contains every requested reconciliation sheet.
All ten ledger/subledger records use the correct transaction-date FX rate and formula-linked USD normalization.
The four matched invoices use correct source amounts, the approved adjustment, differences, and the $1 tolerance status.
Variance_Bridge and Final_Reconciliation are formula-linked and close to the independent matched/unmatched replay.
Changing the 2024-06-30 EUR source rate from 1.07 to 1.08 flows to both INV-101 records and both bridge totals.
Changing approved ADJ-105 from -$50 to -$40 flows to the adjusted amount, difference, and OUT_OF_TOLERANCE status.
Ledger-only and subledger-only exceptions remain distinct and their amounts/counts close to Final_Reconciliation formulas.
Every ledger, subledger, FX-rate, and adjustment-evidence source field is preserved exactly.
Checks expose zero matched difference, two exceptions, and zero final closure residual through formulas.
Penalty for wrong FX lineage, false/tolerance-breaking matches, omitted adjustment, dropped exception, broken closure, or source alteration.
